notes: The queried subject is joined but has no ordinary object-attribute, ordinary interaction, or directed-interaction subscription. A distinct requester subscribes to the standard report interactions, requests the subject's subscription state, and validates all three report shapes, including the MIM-defined NULL responses for an empty object-class subscription, empty ordinary interaction class list, and empty directed-interaction subscription. This is a focused MIM report-shape test, not an overall MOM conformance claim.

requirements.statement: The requester uses the standard sendInteraction service to send HLArequestSubscriptions and identifies the joined subject with the inherited HLAfederate parameter.

The requester subscribes through the standard API to the three MIM report interaction classes so that it can receive the requested object, ordinary-interaction, and directed-interaction subscription reports.

For a subject with no ordinary subscriptions, the object-class report contains only HLAnumberOfClasses encoded as zero and omits HLAobjectClass, HLAactive, HLAmaxUpdateRate, and HLAattributeList; the ordinary interaction report contains an empty HLAinteractionClassList; and the directed-interaction NULL response contains a zero class count, omits HLAobjectClass, and contains an empty HLAinteractionClassList.
